1981-2415-5931-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-5931-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2174-2645-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-6495-7865.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7865.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

967-3809-4247-4772-7087.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

5078-5645-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Stenn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

1263-2438-4871-6112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1902-5295.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-5295.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2615-5434-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-5434-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

191-6625-7178.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-6625-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-2638.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-2638.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2933-4499-5798-6968.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

141-4050-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-4050-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2034-2079-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-6720.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-6720.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-3228-4785-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-4785-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

971-4222-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
971-4222-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

1537-3817-5147-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1506-2178-3523.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1506-2178-3523.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1722-2034-3583-4699.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4699.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

224-2653-3932-4967.notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
224-2653-3932-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Hope Tender.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Thawing Glaciers and the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

190-1321-3303.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Bazaar of Wonders by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Bazaar of Wonders enters the battlefield, exiling all cards from all graveyards.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

766-2232-2858-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Pyromaster onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Pyromaster targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Pyromaster to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
